title: Contract cards built from data
overseerSummary: After the honesty change. Each card states orders, enemy behaviour, fail conditions and bonus terms from the strings the run uses; escalation lines carry their percentages.

proposals.title: Contract card, escalation, side-job and lodging text generated from data, in the engineering register
proposals.problem: Contract blurbs, escalation lines, side-job descriptions, lodging descriptions and about a dozen field log lines are narrative, with aphorism, personification and metaphor, which the user has rejected twice for UI text. Some of it also states mechanics that do not exist: the Retrieval blurb says 'whoever carries it fights one-handed' and no code applies a carrier penalty. The 20 blurbs repeat what the card already prints (terms, exit) while the card omits two things the run does use: the squad's standing orders and the enemy pressure, and the failure terms (m.lose) and bonus terms (m.bonus) are not printed at all.
evidence: missiontypes.js blurbs at 334, 355, 363, 379, 399, 423, 450, 458, 474, 493, 514, 539, 563, 585, 608, 630, 654, 676, 698, 720 (20 strings); copied by roll() at 955 and printed at sortie.js:778 and 1257; sortie.js:740 prints a trial spec's own blurb and quests.js:121 overwrites m.blurb for trial missions, so trials must keep theirs.

missiontypes.js:563 Retrieval blurb 'whoever carries it fights one-handed': grep -i 'handed|carrier' in field.js and missiontypes.js finds no such rule (field.js:1256 carriedBy exists only for subdued marks and wards).

sortie.js:777 already prints terms (objectiveText of m.win) and the exit line; MT.describe (missiontypes.js:1048-1049) returns orders: ORDERS[m.orders] and pressure: PRESSURE[m.pressure] which no card uses; m.lose and m.bonus are returned by describe (win/lose/bonus) but sortie.js:777 prints only win.

missiontypes.js:199-219 ORDERS (8 strings) and PRESSURE (9 strings); the 16 types use 13 distinct (orders, pressure) pairs, pairs shared by survival-waves/hold, recon/rescue, assassination/capture, extermination/duel.

missiontypes.js:837-853 ESCALATION: 16 hand-written lines printed at field.js:1559 (say(s, `‼️ ${esc.line}`)); the effect they describe is field.js:1535-1561: terms become extract-the-squad, hostile groups +50% (field.js:1553), alarm raised, exit mode window for esc.seconds, orders 'avoid'. field.js:1589 passes 'this has run long, and something has noticed' as the reason.

missiontypes.js:759, 767, 776, 785 SIDE_JOBS desc (4 strings), e.g. 'Somebody decides the terms were not ambitious enough'; the data to generate them exists in the same entries (atom, spawn, reward, effect).
economy.js:33-51 LODGINGS desc (7 strings: 'and it shows', 'Everyone else queues'); game.js:1473-1477 already prints beds, rest, morale and plots on the same card.

field.js log lines: 760 'is loose', 880 'the alarm goes up', 1364 'folds shut', 1371 'coming to the noise', 1387 'every minute they do not is paid for', 1396 'the way home slips', 1616 'is not satisfied with that', 1623 and 1866 'that will do', 1804 'comes down'. tactics.js:326 'they read it and go' and tactics.js:383 'and they are trusted with it'.
game.js:2418 altar text says identity is 'locked out of the gate forever'; the Gate tab (game.html:423) is the mission board, and the summon source has no UI name.

test/field.harness.js:86 and 99-100 match log text with /goes on ahead|holds them|stays to hold|they go at those|fall back to the way in|they read it|still coming/. grep shows every one of those strings is in tactics.js (lines 313, 326, 331, 361-362, 383, 408), none in the field.js lines above.
proposals.change:
A) Card. Delete the 20 blurb strings and the blurb copy in roll() (missiontypes.js:955). New MT.brief(m) returns the lines for a contract: orders (ORDERS[m.orders]), pressure (PRESSURE[m.pressure]), 'Fails if: ...' (m.lose minus the wipe atom, via objectiveText) and 'Bonus: ... (+20% of pay each)' (MT.PAYOUT.bonus). sortie.js:778 and 1257 print MT.brief(m) for ordinary contracts and keep m.blurb when m.trial is set. Per-type differences remain because the failure and bonus terms differ per type; the Retrieval claim about one-handed carriers is gone with its sentence.
B) ESCALATION keeps { pressure, seconds } and drops the 16 line strings. field.js:1559 prints a line built from the effect: '‼️ Retrieval gone wrong (<why>): hostile groups +50%, alarm raised, orders: avoid, pressure: <PRESSURE text>'; the 0.5 is MT.ESCALATION_SPAWN, shared with field.js:1553 (introduced in cleanup-contract-honesty). The existing 'New terms: ... inside M:SS' line at 1560 stays. field.js:1589 reason becomes 'ran past the estimated duration with the terms unmet'.
C) SIDE_JOBS desc generated from the entry: silence 'Kill every patrol (at least 2); pays x1.3'; decapitate 'Kill the captain (elite, ancient from level 10); pays x1.45'; plunder 'Work 2-5 caches; pays x1.6'; overreach 'Taken by gamblers; escalates the contract when the terms are met; pays x2.4'. Wording is produced from atom/effect/reward with objectiveText; the card tooltip uses it.
D) LODGINGS: delete desc on six entries (the numbers are on the card); Barracks keeps 'Can be reserved for one team (lodging rules)'. game.js:1473 prints desc only when present.
E) Log lines: 760 'freed'; 880 'seen by <label>: alarm raised'; 1364 'way home shut, reopens in <clock>'; 1371 'alarm raised: +30% hostile groups spawned' (the 0.3 used at field.js:1369); 1387 'holding past the terms adds up to +60%, capped at 0.35 x mission duration' (MT.PORTAL.pay and .overtime); 1396 'way home progress lost: nobody at the point'; 1419 comes from cleanup-contract-honesty; 1616 '<label> took Press their luck: contract escalates'; 1623 and 1866 'extra goals done'; 1804 'destroyed'. tactics.js:326 'no ground to meet them on: leaving'; tactics.js:383 drops ', and they are trusted with it'.
F) test/field.harness.js:99: replace the alternative 'they read it' with the new tactics.js:326 wording, in the same change; the details and stands counters must be identical before and after on `POW=0.6 node test/field.harness.js 40 off on` (the harness is deterministic: two runs of 6 per type produce identical output, verified).
G) game.js:2418: 'their identity and face are removed from the summon pool' and name the pool 'summon pool'.
proposals.playerEffect: Every contract card states what the squad is ordered to do, what the enemy does, what fails the contract and what earns a bonus, using the strings the run itself uses. Escalation and log lines carry numbers the player can verify against the card (+30%, +50%, +60%). No card promises an effect that does not exist.
proposals.secondOrder: Because the escalation line is built from the effect constants, changing +50% changes the text with it. The 16 escalation strings and 20 blurbs stop being content to maintain for each mission type; a new type needs orders, pressure and terms, all of which it already needs. Lodging cards get shorter.
proposals.risks: Types with the same (orders, pressure) pair read alike on those two lines; they still differ in terms, failure terms, bonus and cast, and this change adds the failure and bonus lines to widen that. Log-line edits could change counts in the harness; the harness check in F is the gate. Overlaps cleanup-contract-honesty on missiontypes.js, the card and field.js:1419, so the same owner applies honesty first. Must land before any change that stores log lines (the loop-ledger proposal), so stored text is final.
proposals.response: Split: comment and stale-name fixes (zero behaviour) moved to cleanup-comment-register. Design attack that the harness regexes match the rewritten lines: wrong for the field.js lines (checked: every harness alternative lives in tactics.js); two tactics.js lines are rewritten and the one affected alternative is updated in the same change with a before/after equality gate. Both attackers' demand to keep a per-type line: accepted, but the per-type content is generated from m.lose and m.bonus, which differ per type and are not on the card today, instead of 20 hand-written sentences that include a false claim (one-handed carriers). Engineering demand to generate the escalation line but keep a per-type clause: the line names the contract type and its pressure. Trials: I found that quests.js:121 overwrites blurb for trial missions, so deleting blurbs outright would have emptied the trial card; trials keep theirs.

verdicts.attack: Replacing twenty blurbs with the shared ORDERS/PRESSURE strings makes extermination and raid read identically, and the card already prints terms and exit. The sweep touches nine files the design builders are editing at the same time, and the harness regexes (test/field.harness.js:86, 99-100) match the exact log lines being rewritten.
verdicts.evidenceCheck: Verified: blurbs at missiontypes.js:334, 493, 608 (sampled), ESCALATION lines 837-854, SIDE_JOBS desc 759-785, LODGINGS desc economy.js:32-52, field.js lines 760, 880, 1364, 1371, 1387, 1396, 1419, 1616, 1623, 1804, 1866; combat.js:34-37 is the banned sentence from the ui-prose-engineer-style memory; crew.js:322 'maintenance ... costs to keep' contradicts crew.js:383-387 and game.js:1643-1644; classes.js:1105 'an Adept Killer'; psionic.js:212 'a Temporizer'; game.js:2418 'locked out of the gate'. The pattern grep gives 42 occurrences across 25 files including vendor, facet and tests, so the 28-in-13 count is the game-owned subset.
verdicts.demand: Update the harness regexes in the same change and run the seeded harness before and after for identical outcome lines. Keep one mechanical per-type line on the card built from orders, pressure and the cast summary so types do not read alike. Sequence before loop-ledger so stored log lines are the final text. Fix condition.js:24-27 ('Nothing here reaches into a fight') too, since combat.js:83-88 reads it. Do not touch facet/*.js.

verdicts.attack: Two jobs: (A) comment and contradiction fixes with no information loss; (B) deleting 20 blurbs and 16 escalation lines for shared ORDERS/PRESSURE strings, which makes extermination and raid read identically and drops the per-type information the blurbs carry (what to carry, who to keep alive). The user's rule is register, not the removal of per-type description; one mechanical sentence per type satisfies both. It overlaps contract-honesty on missiontypes.js, sortie.js:768-787 and field.js:1419.
verdicts.evidenceCheck: Verified the banned sentence at combat.js:34-37; crew.js:322 'maintenance, sized to what a town costs to keep' against crew.js:383 'INCOME rather than a bill' and game.js:1643-1645 'NOTHING DRAINS GEMS'; psionic.js:212 'Temporizer' and classes.js:1105 'an Adept Killer'; field.js:1364/1371/1387/1396/1419 lines; ESCALATION at missiontypes.js:837-853; blurbs printed at sortie.js:778 and 1257; game.js:2418 'locked out of the gate'; the harness regexes (test/field.harness.js:86, 99-100) match tactics.js lines, none of which this proposal edits.
verdicts.demand: 1) Split: A ships as an S with zero behaviour change. 2) For B, rewrite each blurb as one mechanical sentence per type covering terms not already on the card, instead of deleting; generate the escalation line from the constants but keep a per-type clause. 3) One owner with contract-honesty for the shared lines.
